### CVE-2005-0736
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2005-03-13 | Updated: 2024-08-07 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 1397: Linux Kernel 2.6.9 < 2.6.11 (RHEL 4) - 'SYS_EPoll_Wait' Local Integer Overflow / Local Privilege Escalation (local/linux, 2005-12-30, verified=1)
- Exploit-DB 25202: Linux Kernel 2.6.x - 'SYS_EPoll_Wait' Local Integer Overflow / Local Privilege Escalation (1) (local/linux, 2005-03-09, verified=1)

Integer overflow in sys_epoll_wait in eventpoll.c for Linux kernel 2.6 to 2.6.11 allows local users to overwrite kernel memory via a large number of events.

### CVE-2005-0750
- Assigner: redhat | Published: 2005-04-03 | Updated: 2024-08-07 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 25287: Linux Kernel 2.4.x/2.6.x - BlueTooth Signed Buffer Index (PoC) (dos/linux, 2005-03-28, verified=1)
- Exploit-DB 25289: Linux Kernel 2.4.30/2.6.11.5 - BlueTooth 'bluez_sock_create' Local Privilege Escalation (local/linux, 2005-10-19, verified=1)
- Exploit-DB 926: Linux Kernel 2.4.x/2.6.x - 'Bluez' BlueTooth Signed Buffer Index Privilege Escalation (2) (local/linux, 2005-10-26, verified=1)
- Exploit-DB 25288: Linux Kernel 2.4.x/2.6.x - BlueTooth Signed Buffer Index Privilege Escalation (1) (local/linux, 2005-04-08, verified=1)

The bluez_sock_create function in the Bluetooth stack for Linux kernel 2.4.6 through 2.4.30-rc1 and 2.6 through 2.6.11.5 allows local users to gain privileges via (1) socket or (2) socketpair call with a negative protocol value.

### CVE-2005-0916
- Assigner: redhat | Published: 2005-03-29 | Updated: 2024-08-07 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 911: Linux Kernel PPC64/IA64 (AIO) - Local Denial of Service (dos/linux, 2005-04-04, verified=1)

AIO in the Linux kernel 2.6.11 on the PPC64 or IA64 architectures with CONFIG_HUGETLB_PAGE enabled allows local users to cause a denial of service (system panic) via a process that executes the io_queue_init function but exits without running io_queue_release, which causes exit_aio and is_hugepage_only_range to fail.

Affected:
- n/a / n/a: affected n/a

### CVE-2005-1263
- Assigner: redhat | Published: 2005-05-11 | Updated: 2024-08-07 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 25647: Linux Kernel 2.2.x/2.3.x/2.4.x/2.5.x/2.6.x - ELF Core Dump Local Buffer Overflow (PoC) (dos/linux, 2005-05-11, verified=1)

The elf_core_dump function in binfmt_elf.c for Linux kernel 2.x.x to 2.2.27-rc2, 2.4.x to 2.4.31-pre1, and 2.6.x to 2.6.12-rc4 allows local users to execute arbitrary code via an ELF binary that, in certain conditions involving the create_elf_tables function, causes a negative length argument to pass a signed integer comparison, leading to a buffer overflow.

### CVE-2005-1589
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2005-05-17 | Updated: 2024-08-07 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 998: Linux Kernel 2.6.12-rc4 - 'ioctl_by_bdev' Local Denial of Service (dos/linux, 2005-05-17, verified=1)

The pkt_ioctl function in the pktcdvd block device ioctl handler (pktcdvd.c) in Linux kernel 2.6.12-rc4 and earlier calls the wrong function before passing an ioctl to the block device, which crosses security boundaries by making kernel address space accessible from user space and allows local users to cause a denial of service and possibly execute arbitrary code, a similar vulnerability to CVE-2005-1264.

Affected:
- n/a / n/a: affected n/a

### CVE-2005-2709
- Assigner: redhat | Published: 2005-11-20 | Updated: 2024-08-07 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 26489: Linux Kernel 2.6.x - Sysctl Unregistration Local Denial of Service (dos/linux, 2005-11-09, verified=1)

The sysctl functionality (sysctl.c) in Linux kernel before 2.6.14.1 allows local users to cause a denial of service (kernel oops) and possibly execute code by opening an interface file in /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/, waiting until the interface is unregistered, then obtaining and modifying function pointers in memory that was used for the ctl_table.

### CVE-2005-2800
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2005-09-06 | Updated: 2024-08-07 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 26248: Linux Kernel 2.6.x - SCSI ProcFS Denial of Service (dos/linux, 2005-09-09, verified=1)

Memory leak in the seq_file implementation in the SCSI procfs interface (sg.c) in Linux kernel 2.6.13 and earlier allows local users to cause a denial of service (memory consumption) via certain repeated reads from the /proc/scsi/sg/devices file, which is not properly handled when the next() iterator returns NULL or an error.

### CVE-2005-3257
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2005-10-18 | Updated: 2024-08-07 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 26353: Linux Kernel 2.6 - Console Keymap Local Command Injection (local/linux, 2005-10-17, verified=1)
